tools.name: list_graphs
tools.description: List all configured graphs with their nicknames. Also provides setup instructions for connecting additional graphs.

tools.name: setup_new_graph
tools.description: Set up a new Roam graph for access, or list available graphs. Call without arguments to see which graphs are available in Roam Desktop. Call with graph and nickname to connect a specific graph — ask the user what they'd like to call the graph before choosing a nickname. The user will see an approval dialog in Roam desktop app and must approve the token request. If the graph is already configured, returns the existing configuration without making changes.

graph.description: The canonical Roam graph name. Omit graph and nickname to list available graphs.

nickname.description: A short, memorable label describing what this graph is for (e.g. 'my personal graph', 'work notes', 'book club'). Ask the user what they call this graph — use their natural language, not hyphenated format. Do not just copy the graph name. Required when graph is provided.

tools.name: get_graph_guidelines
tools.description: IMPORTANT: Call this tool first when starting to work with a graph, before performing any other operations. Returns user-defined instructions and preferences for AI agents. The user may have specified naming conventions, preferred structures, or constraints that should guide your behavior.

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: create_page
tools.description:
Create a new page in Roam, optionally with markdown content.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: create_block
tools.description:
Create a new block under a parent, using markdown content. Supports nested bulleted lists - pass a markdown string with `- ` list items and indentation to create an entire block hierarchy in a single call.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

parentUid.description: UID of parent block or page

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: update_block
tools.description:
Update an existing block's content or properties.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: delete_block
tools.description:
Delete a block and all its children.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: move_block
tools.description:
Move a block to a new location.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

parentUid.description: UID of the new parent block or page

order.description: Position in the new parent (number, 'first', or 'last')

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description:
Delete a page and all its contents.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: update_page
tools.description:
Update a page's title or children view type. Set mergePages to true if renaming to a title that already exists.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

childrenViewType.description: How children are displayed (document, bullet, or numbered)

mergePages.description: If true, merge with existing page when renaming to a title that already exists (default: false)

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search for pages and blocks by text. Returns paginated results with markdown content and optional breadcrumb paths.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

scope.description: Search scope: 'pages' for page titles only, 'blocks' for block content only, 'all' for both (default: 'all')

includePath.description: Include breadcrumb path to each result (default: true)

maxDepth.description: Max depth of children to include in markdown (default: 0)

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description:
Search Roam templates by name. When the user mentions 'my X template' or 'the X template', use this tool to find it. Templates are user-created reusable content blocks tagged with [[roam/templates]]. Returns template name, uid, and content as markdown.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

query.description: Keywords to filter templates by name (case-insensitive). Try relevant keywords first before listing all.

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: roam_query
tools.description:
Execute a Roam query ({{query: }} or {{[[query]]: }} blocks, NOT Datalog). Two modes: (1) UID mode - pass a block UID containing a query component to run it with saved settings/filters; (2) Query mode - pass a raw query string like "{and: [[TODO]] {not: [[DONE]]}}". Returns paginated results with markdown content.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

uid.description: UID of a block containing {{query: ...}} or {{[[query]]: ...}} - uses the block's saved display settings and filters

query.description: Raw Roam query string (e.g., "{and: [[TODO]] {not: [[DONE]]}}") - NOT Datalog - results are flat list, no user filters applied

sort.description: Sort order (only for query mode, default: created-date)

sortOrder.description: Sort direction (only for query mode, default: desc)

includePath.description: Include breadcrumb path in results (only for query mode, default: true)

maxDepth.description: Max depth of children to include in markdown (default: 1)

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: get_page
tools.description:
Get a page's content as markdown. Returns content with <roam> metadata tags containing UIDs - use these for follow-up operations but strip them when showing content to the user. Show remaining content verbatim, never paraphrase. Use maxDepth for large pages.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

maxDepth.description: Max depth of children to include in markdown (omit for full tree)

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: get_block
tools.description:
Get a block's content as markdown. Returns content with <roam> metadata tags containing UIDs - use these for follow-up operations but strip them when showing content to the user. Show remaining content verbatim, never paraphrase. Use maxDepth for large blocks.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

maxDepth.description: Max depth of children to include in markdown (omit for full tree)

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: get_backlinks
tools.description:
Get paginated backlinks (linked references) for a page or block, formatted as markdown. Returns total count and results with optional breadcrumb paths.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

uid.description: UID of page or block (required if no title)

search.description: Filter results by text match (searches block, parents, children, page title)

includePath.description: Include breadcrumb path to each result (default: true)

maxDepth.description: Max depth of children to include in markdown (default: 2)

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: file_get
tools.description:
Fetch a file hosted on Roam (handles decryption for encrypted graphs).

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

url.description: Firebase storage URL of the file

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: file_upload
tools.description:
Upload a file to Roam. Returns the Firebase storage URL. Usually you'll want to create a new block with the file as markdown: `![](url)`. Provide ONE of: filePath (preferred - local file, server reads directly), url (remote URL, server fetches), or base64 (raw data, fallback for sandboxed clients).

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

filePath.description: Local file path (preferred) - server reads the file directly

url.description: Remote URL to fetch the file from

base64.description: Base64-encoded file data (fallback for sandboxed clients)

mimetype.description: MIME type (e.g., image/png, image/jpeg) - auto-detected if not provided

filename.description: Original filename for reference - derived from path/url if not provided

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)

tools.name: file_delete
tools.description:
Delete a file hosted on Roam.

Note: Call get_graph_guidelines first when starting to work with a graph.

url.description: Firebase storage URL of the file to delete

graph.description: Graph nickname or name (optional - auto-selects if only one graph is configured)
